commonPrompt: Use case: identity-preserve / wardrobe try-on. Create one finished square premium character costume lineup illustration for an art director to review. The attached image is the sole identity reference for Huang Xiaoxi, the same cute stylized Chinese 3D game companion wearing different clothes. Absolutely preserve her recognizable warm brown eyes, facial geometry, small mouth, youthful proportions (large head, compact body), skin tone, same dark hair root, tiny smile, polished tactile embroidered-fabric and metal 3D rendering. Keep her age, body scale, camera, soft frontal light consistent in every cell. Recreate this EXACT SAME CHARACTER six times in SIX genuinely different outfits. Flattering age-appropriate fashion. Strict 3 columns x 2 rows. All six head-to-toe, aligned heads & feet per row, roughly equal figure heights, shoes always visible, clean equal margins, no touching figures or silhouettes crossing panels. Neutral warm ivory seamless studio background and subtle contact shadows. Nothing else on the sheet: no labels, text, numbers, slogans, logos, borders, title, extra props, mannequins, details insets or decorative graphics. Primary focus on strikingly distinct garment silhouettes and construction that read at a glance when rendered monochrome: trousers vs skirts, waistlines, sleeves, hem geometry. Use Miao-inspired silverwork or embroidery judiciously as specific design details; designs are contemporary creative interpretations. Give each outfit its own practical small hairstyle/hair ornament rather than repeating one ornate crown everywhere. Natural frontal modeling with both arms separated slightly from torso, same face visible. Design each outfit as a separable head/hair accessory, upper piece, bottom piece, and shoes; for long dresses tuck or overlap top into high-waisted skirt to look like a continuous dress. No one-piece dress, no irreversible layer crossing the joints. Left-to-right row-major order as follows.

boards.title: 山野旅行
boards.prompt:
Design direction A: "A wardrobe for a walk through Guizhou". Sophisticated tactile travelwear, indigo, moss, saffron and water colors, one small identifiable handcrafted detail per simple starter look, theatrical but wearable collectible rewards.
1 TOP LEFT (field explorer): short moss waxed-cotton trapeze rain cape over an oatmeal stand-neck shirt; long sand straight hiking trousers, lace-up leather trail boots, short braid tied with one small hammered silver leaf clip. Make cape and trousers unmistakable.
2 TOP CENTER (city traveller): warm marigold cropped bomber with ribbed cuffs and tiny embroidered geometric placket, ink navy high-waisted tailored Bermuda shorts with pressed creases, ivory high-top sneakers, high dark ponytail with a simple silver spiral buckle. Sporty city silhouette.
3 TOP RIGHT (brook): ivory cotton blouse with rolled sleeves and narrow mint neck scarf, sea-glass wrap midi skirt with an asymmetrical diagonal hem and tiny silver drop fastener, light canvas slip-ons, loose low twisted braid. Airy and understated.
4 BOTTOM LEFT (welcome gift): iconic festive vermilion stand-collar jacket with modest bell cuffs, deeply pleated near-black knee skirt and a richly embroidered red front apron panel, dainty embroidered red shoes, sculptural silver flower headdress. Echo the original doll’s cultural identity in this one signature look only.
5 BOTTOM CENTER (mountain overlook reward): cloud-grey pale wide-sleeved Chinese crossed-collar short top, separate midnight-teal high-waisted nearly ankle-length structured skirt with silver contour lines winding like mountain ridges and a clean deep pleat. A single slender silver hairpin, dark cloth boots. Mountain-wind hanfu-inspired silhouette, keep hands visible.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT (brook & craft shop reward): pale pink fitted linen blouse with gently puffed short sleeves, long flowing asymmetric petal skirt made from layered rose and plum gauze, tiny embroidered plum buds and one silver flower clasp at waist, floral hair comb, low rose strap shoes visible. Adult-quality fabric work on the reference girl. Distinguish light translucent long skirt from structured fifth look.

boards.title: 都市银饰
boards.prompt:
Design direction B: a contemporary capsule created by an experimental city designer with a Guizhou silver atelier. Editorial, urban, tailored, textile-rich, age-appropriate. Diversity of cut, not a uniform. Avoid cargo cape, imperial robes and the original red costume.
1 TOP LEFT: cropped boxy indigo denim chore jacket with contrast topstitching and individual small silver buttons, cream balloon-leg barrel trousers with folded hems, brown chunky loafers; tidy dark bob with a single hammered silver barrette. Compact square upper silhouette.
2 TOP CENTER: pale sunflower tailored short blazer with just one embroidered cuff and single silver frog closure, charcoal gently flared short skort, cream ankle boots with black elastic sides; clean high braided bun. Sharp graphic A-line city silhouette.
3 TOP RIGHT: mint knitted zip sailor top with large squared back collar turned out at shoulders, separate three-quarter straight marine sailor trousers with a narrow embroidered outer stripe, slim white canvas sneakers; low braided pigtails held with tiny silver ends. Quiet nautical city look.
4 BOTTOM LEFT: elegant ink-black asymmetric mandarin stand collar vest over a warm ivory long-sleeve shirt, black tapered ankle trousers, low oxblood lace-up shoes, side-part low bun and a sculptural silver twisted comb. Large burnished silver butterfly toggle at one shoulder and asymmetrical indigo brocade panel. This gift look has recognizably different tailored lines from the starters.
5 BOTTOM CENTER: an architectural ultra-short midnight-blue capelet jacket with sculptural lantern sleeves and a small silver torque collar, over a separate sculpted flared silver-grey ankle skirt with fanlike sharp radiating origami pleats. Moon-shaped silver pin in high bun, graphite ankle boots. Runway silhouette riffing on mountains, clearly show waist and feet.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT: a pearly blush short-sleeved fitted bolero over ivory blouse, separate apricot ankle-length translucent tiered tulle A-line skirt, with visible embroidered dark rose floral stems winding across just one panel. Silver blossom hairband and ballet flats. Artisan city occasionwear, full skirt and shoes visible.

boards.title: 山水新国风
boards.prompt:
Design direction C: a sophisticated storybook wardrobe for a journey through mountains and streams. New Chinese fashion with subtle Miao-inspired silver engraving or woven stitch motifs. Clouded mineral colors, indigo, persimmon, pale tea and plum. Deliberate blend of casual garments, different skirt volumes and one special long crossed-collar hanfu-inspired look. No weapons, umbrellas, handheld props, magic effects or oversized crown repetition.
1 TOP LEFT: a tea-green sleeveless short Chinese stand collar waistcoat over an ecru shirt with neatly cuffed sleeves; separate dark indigo loose lantern trousers gathered at the ankles and soft lace-up cloth boots. Side braid with a single flat silver bird pin. Vertical, practical traveller silhouette.
2 TOP CENTER: sunny persimmon cropped crossover cape blouse with scalloped shoulder yoke and one small silver sun clasp, separate ivory short box-pleated culotte/skort, chestnut riding ankle boots, small ribboned bun. Brisk, short, graphic silhouette; arms and hands visible.
3 TOP RIGHT: misty ivory narrow-sleeve wrap blouse with mint folded lapel, separate calf-length two-panel sheer jade over-skirt tied in an off-center bow, white embroidered flat shoes, loose dark hair kept back by an understated silver comb. A waterlike airy shape.
4 BOTTOM LEFT: fitted oyster silk blouse beneath a short indigo shoulder mantle ending at waist, rows of hammered silver drops at its curved bib edge, separate calf-length ochre and ink paneled apron-skirt with a curved asymmetric side opening over a second opaque skirt, dark strap shoes. Secure silver spiral headdress around dark hair. Ceremonial craft-inspired gift with a strong apron silhouette.
5 BOTTOM CENTER: a historically-inspired but creative two-piece hanfu for the mountaintop: luminous ivory cross-collar upper jacket with generous wide square sleeves and thin silver-embroidered edges, dark peacock-blue long structured pleated skirt with a central cloud-and-mountain tapestry panel, dark soft shoes visible, neat updo with elongated silver filigree hairpin. Air under sleeves and skirt drape are essential.
6 BOTTOM RIGHT: botanical atelier outfit: short fitted cranberry jacket with narrow three-quarter sleeves, separate pomegranate-red ankle-length skirt formed of overlapping broad petals, embroidered silver-and-rose flowers asymmetrically at hem and hip. Low braided crown with small silver blossom pins; red cloth Mary Jane shoes. Clean modern petal dress silhouette with no long sleeves or historical train.
